description:
Implement the spec in .openspec/specs/enterprise-port/spec.md. Pipeline for this order is sdlc-default (software domain, the factory repo itself), selected by the run workflow.

EXECUTION: this order is filed and fired on the owner's order of 2026-11-15 (unlike the staged reform orders wo-gh-40 to wo-gh-42, whose execution waits). Run configuration baseline, unchanged by this filing: the order is parented on factory main 7dcc0e0d353974a15f79e2610e6447c66c92a04b, whose anvil.yaml carries max_run_tokens 6000000, max_runtime_turns 40 and max_packet_tokens 48000, and whose anvil.json wires the checks command (python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py').

SOURCE ARTIFACT: the owner-supplied patch at work-orders/artifacts/issue-44-anvil-enterprise-port.patch (17 files, about 1220 added lines, produced outside this repository). It was cut against a divergent base and does not apply to current main (its tools/dispatch_station.py hunks fail git apply --check). Treat the patch as source material and evidence for the spec requirements, never as a diff to apply. Where the patch and the spec's decision basis conflict, the spec wins.

BUILD, per the spec requirements:
R1: factory .gitignore gains the patch's secret and credential rules; templates/project.gitignore is added; anvil/scaffold.py installs the template when a new project has no .gitignore and never overwrites an existing one; the patch's greenfield pipeline wording fix in scaffold lands with it.
R2: tests/test_secret_scan.py arrives as a new file: it scans tracked factory files for the credential patterns it names and fails naming file and pattern; it passes on the ported tree.
R3: anvil/telemetry.py gains the Copilot parsing from the patch (token usage from the session accounting snapshot, failure reason from its session.error event), wired into the existing runtime path (tools/claude_station.py and tools/copilot_runtime.py). No new station wrapper file is created; the patch's tools/copilot_station.py is not ported as a file.
R4: every Copilot model mapping contains only Anthropic models (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-fable-5-2, dotted where the runtime requires it). A configured non-Anthropic model under ANVIL_RUNTIME=copilot fails loudly with no fallback. The patch's dispatch changes land only where they serve decision 0010's runtime selection; default gateway dispatch behaviour is unchanged.
R5: tools/sync_project_usage.py gains --allow-private: private and internal repositories are refused without it, imported with it.
R6: docs/OPERATOR-GUIDE.md is added, ported from the patch and corrected to the single-wrapper, Anthropic-only, gateway-default design; docs/EXECUTION.md gains the patch's runtime section in the same corrected form; README.md and CHANGELOG.md gain the patch's entries with the same corrections.
R7: the patch's tests arrive as new files under tests/, adapted to the single-wrapper design (secret scan, sync usage, Copilot usage parsing, failure reason, Anthropic-only map, loud failure on a non-Anthropic id). Existing test files at the base ref are not modified. Full suite green, check-skills PASS.

RECONCILIATION WITH ACTIVE DECISIONS (read before building; these are settled, not discoveries): decision 0008 (one model family, no OpenAI route), decision 0010 (ANVIL_RUNTIME selects the runtime, one wrapper holds the station contract for both, gateway default), decision 0012 (Anthropic only; opus 5.5 workhorse, fable 5.2 only for approver and supervisor). Note decision 0010's open point: the Copilot usage statistics shape is confirmed on the first real run; the patch's telemetry parsing is the enterprise variant's answer to that shape and is ported as such, with fixtures from the patch's tests as the evidence.

BUILDER REPORT REQUIRED LITERALS: the builder report (runs/wo-gh-44/builder.output.md) must contain each of these in full, unabbreviated: 7dcc0e0d353974a15f79e2610e6447c66c92a04b, enterprise-port, test_secret_scan.py, Anthropic-only. It must also state the exact full factory test count from the suite run and the names of the new test files added.

GUARDRAILS: authorized surface for this order: .gitignore, templates/project.gitignore, anvil/scaffold.py, anvil/telemetry.py, tools/claude_station.py, tools/copilot_runtime.py, tools/dispatch_station.py (only where R4 requires it), tools/sync_project_usage.py, docs/OPERATOR-GUIDE.md, docs/EXECUTION.md, README.md, CHANGELOG.md, .openspec/specs/project-scaffolding/spec.md (the patch's amendment only), and new test files under tests/. Pipeline files under pipelines/ are protected paths in anvil.json; the port must hold without editing them. anvil.json itself is protected; do not edit it. The filed spec under .openspec/specs/enterprise-port/ and the source artifact under work-orders/artifacts/ are inputs, not build surface. Existing test files at the base ref are protected: do not modify or delete them; new tests arrive as new files. Python standard library only, no new dependency. No em dash or en dash character in any produced file. No employer or organization names beyond ANVIL and arananet in any produced file. Nothing in this order merges, publishes or deploys anything; the run stops at the owner human gate.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/arananet/anvil-factory/issues/44
title: Enterprise port: secret hygiene, Copilot telemetry and operator guide on the single-runtime design
